rules: Append-mostly: rows are never deleted; incorrect rows move to WontFix.
Done requires a corresponding V2_*_READY packet to ship and Codex to pass.
Codex reviewers must consult this tracker before any live-canary or production-equivalence approval.

findings.title: Zero live ingestors running
findings.detail: 13 legacy ingestors (Binance/KuCoin/CoinAPI/CoinAnk/LunarCrush/TokenMetrics/AlphaVantage/realtime_price_provider/coinank global aggregator/coinank pipeline monitor/live_technical_analysis/feature_pipeline) have no running V2 native equivalent.

findings.title: RL trainer not ported
findings.detail: hybrid_trainer.py 57k LOC has no V2 native loop; rl_core/service.py declares itself SUBPROJECT_1_RL_CORE_PARTIALLY_MIGRATED_PAPER_ONLY.

findings.title: Live trader not ported
findings.detail: trading/trader.py (24k LOC) and 34 other trading files have no V2 live-capable port; V2 has paper canary only.

findings.title: AI model not loaded in paper loop
findings.detail: V2 paper loop uses heuristic/rule-based decisions, not the trained PPO+MASA policy. checkpoint_metadata.py parses filenames only.

findings.title: Live-canary scaffold remains dry-run only
findings.detail: No real order has shipped; live_gate stays blocked_human_only and live_symbols=[].
findings.closing_gate: V2_LIVE_CANARY_FIRST_REAL_ORDER_READY (requires explicit operator + Codex final approval)

findings.title: Trader sub-components missing
findings.detail: Stealth stops, dynamic TP, hedge engines, smart entry gate, market regime detector, maker execution etc. have no V2 port.

findings.title: Feature pipeline reads snapshots not live feeds
findings.detail: V2 feature snapshot builder reads from paper data files, not live Redis feeds.
findings.closing_gate: blocked by AUD-001 (live ingestors must exist first)

findings.title: FastAPI backend not running
findings.detail: uvicorn process was absent; frontend /api/v1 and /api/v2 calls were failing.

findings.title: REDIS_URL / LEGACY_REDIS_URL not set
findings.detail: v2/backend/app/settings.py has env_file=None; no .env existed; V2 workers relied on shell env that was unset.
findings.closing_gate: V2_PUBLIC_WEBSITE_BACKEND_ONLINE_READY (backend systemd unit injects REDIS_URL=redis://localhost:6379/0 and LEGACY_REDIS_URL=redis://localhost:6379/0)

findings.title: No auto-restart watchdog for V2 services
findings.detail: Legacy auto_recovery.sh was removed; V2 has no equivalent. v2_production_replacement_runtime_guard.py monitors but does not restart.

findings.title: No Telegram alerts in V2
findings.detail: Legacy telegram_alerts.py (2,243 lines) has no V2 equivalent. Operators would receive no alerts from V2.

findings.title: No database set up; alembic migrations not run
findings.detail: pyproject.toml declares SQLAlchemy+alembic but DATABASE_URL is blank and no SQLite/Postgres exists.

findings.title: Dry-run approval binding broken on operator's prose file
findings.detail: parse_approval_file used strict KEY: VALUE matching; operator's actual approval file uses natural-language prose, so the envelope fell back to closed_default. Intent records mis-reported approval_file_present=False.

findings.title: Critical missing pip packages in V2 venv
findings.detail: torchaudio, torchvision, pytorch_triton, grpcio, pynvml, nvidia_ml_py, trio, trio_websocket, nest_asyncio, tzdata, retrying — 11+ critical packages absent.

findings.title: Pandas 3.0 in V2 vs 2.3.3 in legacy
findings.detail: Pandas 3.0 is mandatory Copy-on-Write; many deprecated APIs removed. Any V2 code reading legacy DataFrames is at risk.

findings.title: Pydantic 2.9.2 (V2) vs 2.12.5 (legacy)
findings.detail: Breaking changes between 2.9 and 2.12 may surface if V2 imports legacy models.

findings.title: redis-py 5.0.8 (V2) vs 7.1.0 (legacy)
findings.detail: Async API differences across the 5→7 jump; client.json() response shapes differ.

findings.title: fastapi 0.115.0 (V2) vs 0.128.0 (legacy)
findings.detail: Older fastapi in V2 may miss security fixes / Starlette features.

findings.title: uvicorn 0.30.6 (V2) vs 0.40.0 (legacy)
findings.detail: Older uvicorn in V2; bundled with the fastapi upgrade work.

findings.title: Torch nightly-dev (legacy) vs stable (V2)
findings.detail: Legacy uses 2.10.0.dev20250930+cu128; V2 uses 2.10.0+cu128. If V2 ever loads legacy checkpoints, nightly-only APIs may fail.

findings.title: Legacy config.py (6,006 lines) has no V2 equivalent
findings.detail: V2 settings.py is 26 lines. Many tunable parameters (LEVERAGE, MARGIN_TYPE, INTELLIGENCE_STEALTH_TP_GATE_ENABLED, POST_CASCADE_*, LOSS_REALIZATION_*, HEDGE_*) have no V2 counterpart.
